title: Polyamor Bootshaus w/ DAVYBOI, PRADA2000, MIKA HEGGEMANN & many more
sourceDescription: Cologne, are you ready? Polyamor is taking over Bootshaus with its biggest show yet. Get ready for pure Polyamor madness, top-notch production, and a stacked lineup.
dbDescription: Age for Admission 18 years / Einlass ab 18 Jahren! All sales are final / Jeder Kauf ist endg&uuml;ltig No refund by artist cancellation / Kein Umtausch bei Artist Absage For identification and as proof of age we only accept an official ID: identity card, passport, driver's license. We cannot accept these documents as proof: Student ID, health insurance card, bank card/credit card, photos or scans of any identification documents. Tickets, die als verloren oder gestohlen gemeldet werden, oder mit einem Preisaufschlag weiterverkauft werden, werden gesperrt!
